description.ja: 可変ＭＳ MSZ-006C1 ゼータプラスＣ１が 遂にＨＧＵＣにラインアップ！！
description.en: Variable MS MSZ-006C1 Zeta Plus C1 is finally available in HGUC lineup! !

description.en: From "Gundam Sentinel", the Earth Federation military space variable MS Zeta Plus C1 type is commercialized in the HGUC series.
